source_text: {Although we have only discussed simplicial triangulations to this point, finite element spaces based on meshes of $n$-dimensional boxes (products of intervals) are also popular. It turns out that there are two families of finite element spaces on boxes which are in many ways parallel to the $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ and $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ spaces on simplices and which we summarize in this section.}
translated_text: {虽然迄今只讨论了单纯形剖分, 基于 $n$ 维长方体 (区间之积) 网格的有限元空间也很常用. 原来, 长方体上有两族有限元空间, 它们在许多方面与单纯形上的 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ 和 $\mathcal P_r^-\Lambda^k$ 空间相对应, 本节将对此作简要介绍.}

source_text: {The simpler of the two families is denoted by $\mathcal Q_r^-\Lambda^k$. It is defined on an arbitrary mesh of boxes $\mathcal T_h$ in $\mathbb R^n$ and for every $r>0$ and $0\leq k\leq n$. To define the space, we need to supply shape functions and DOFs on an arbitrary box $T\subset\mathbb R^n$. This can be done using the appropriate notion of a tensor product of chain complexes. Here we quickly recall the results, which are extracted from \BookCite{9}, to which we refer for details.}
translated_text: {两族中较简单的一族记为 $\mathcal Q_r^-\Lambda^k$. 它对 $\mathbb R^n$ 中的任意长方体网格 $\mathcal T_h$, 以及每个 $r>0$ 和 $0\leq k\leq n$ 定义. 为定义该空间, 需要给出任意长方体 $T\subset\mathbb R^n$ 上的形函数和自由度. 利用链复形张量积的适当概念就能做到这一点. 这里简要回顾取自 \BookCite{9} 的结果, 细节请参见该文.}

source_text: {We remark that some additional families of cubical finite element differential forms have been proposed at least in two or three dimensions, sharing many of the same properties. In particular, we note the TNT element of Cockburn and Qiu \BookCite{33} and the trimmed serendipity family of Gillette and Kloefkorn \BookCite{44}. Another remark is that for all these cubical elements, including these discussed above, there is a major loss of accuracy if the cube is mapped not to a box or a parallelepided but to a more general shape (such as a convex quadrilateral in two dimensions, or some sort of hexahedron in three dimensions). This effect, which becomes more pronounced the larger the form degree of the elements, was studied in \BookCite{9}. Some elements which avoid this have recently been constructed by Arbogast and collaborators \BookCite{3}, \BookCite{4}.}
translated_text: {还要指出, 至少在二维或三维中, 已有人提出其他一些立方体有限元微分形式族, 它们具有许多相同的性质. 特别值得一提的是 Cockburn 和 Qiu 的 TNT 单元 \BookCite{33}, 以及 Gillette 和 Kloefkorn 的修剪 Serendipity 族 \BookCite{44}. 另一个要点是, 对所有这些立方体单元, 包括上面讨论的单元, 若将立方体映射到的不是长方体或平行六面体, 而是更一般的形状 (例如二维中的凸四边形, 或三维中的某种六面体), 则会出现严重的精度损失. 单元的形式次数越高, 这一效应越明显; \BookCite{9} 研究了这种效应. 近来 Arbogast 及其合作者构造了一些避免该问题的单元 \BookCite{3}, \BookCite{4}.}
